description: Wire contract for the JSON object a Codex PermissionRequest command hook reads from stdin. PermissionRequest runs only when Codex is about to request approval, and its matcher filters the canonical tool name and supported aliases.

agent_id.description: Present only for approval requests made inside a subagent.

agent_type.description: Present only for approval requests made inside a subagent.

cwd.description: Session working directory; may be a repository subdirectory.

tool_input.description: Tool-specific JSON input. Bash and apply_patch use command; description may be a string or null when Codex supplies an approval reason.

tool_name.description: Canonical hook tool name, such as Bash, apply_patch, or an MCP tool name.

title: Codex PermissionRequest command-hook input
